notes: This package raises the two remaining 1-2-program northern institutions to five formal-plus-candidate programs and adds three officially verified regional universities.
All 16 programs are explicitly available to international students; no domestic-student catalog or third-party aggregator was used as evidence.
Every public-facing name and evidence summary is complete in English, Chinese and Russian with no translation placeholders.
Only Hebei Normal University's December 2026 four-week Chinese-language route remains open as of 2026-08-05; every passed 2026 deadline is explicitly closed.
Ningxia Medical University stable program and funding facts are retained without inventing a current cycle because its detailed official catalog does not publish current dates.
All non-empty scholarship-to-program references resolve to candidate IDs inside this package; candidate IDs and same-school program names were checked against the formal catalog.
